citation.sourceNote: §72(t)(1): tax is increased by "10 percent of the portion of such amount which is includible in gross income" for a distribution from a qualified plan, unless (t)(2) excepts it: (A)(i) on or after age 59½; (A)(iii) disability; (A)(iv) substantially equal periodic payments; (A)(v) "after separation from service after attainment of age 55", which (t)(10) lowers to age 50 or 25 years of service for qualified public-safety employees and Pub. 575 reads as separation "in or after the year you reached age 55"; (B) medical expenses deductible under §213; (C) an alternate payee under a QDRO; (H) a birth or adoption, up to $5,000; (I) one emergency personal expense distribution a year, up to "the lesser of $1,000" or the vested balance over $1,000; (K) a domestic abuse victim, up to the lesser of $10,000 (indexed) or half the balance; (L) terminal illness. §3405(c)(1)(B): the payor of an eligible rollover distribution "shall withhold ... 20 percent", unless (c)(2) it is paid directly to another plan. The distribution is ordinary income. Read 2026-10-19.
